description:
Know what the market is actually doing — not just price. Live orderflow from 20 exchanges across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, BNB, Dogecoin, Avalanche, Cardano, Chainlink, and 15 more tokens. Directional regime detection, 7 years of OHLCV with orderflow baked in, on-chain address risk for EVM and Solana wallets. Free here on Smithery. Deploy 24/7 agents via the REST API at x402.tunedfor.ai — no API key, no subscription, pay USDC per call.


Claude users — paste this URL into "Add custom connector" instead of the one below:
https://x402.tunedfor.ai/mcp

Same server, no proxy, no OAuth. (Smithery's proxy URL requires OAuth that Claude's dialog doesn't currently negotiate

tools.name: market.snapshot
tools.description: Live market snapshot — 16 reliably populated fields, no LLM, no interpretation. Returns price_usd, change_pct_24h, volume_24h_usd, market_cap_usd, funding_rate, open_interest_usd, cvd_1h, buy_ratio, whale_bar_count_1h, liquidation_buy_1h, liquidation_sell_1h, cvd_divergence, spot_perp_delta, volume_herfindahl, fear_greed, fear_greed_label. Cost: 0.20 USDC. 15 tokens: BTC ETH SOL XRP ADA DOGE AVAX LINK BNB ATOM DOT ARB SUI OP LTC

token.description: Token symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, LINK, BNB, ATOM, DOT, ARB, SUI, OP, LTC)

max_age_seconds.description: Freshness contract — reject cached data older than N seconds. Default: 3600.

tools.name: market.analyze
tools.description: Pre-trade macro check. Data-only, no LLM. Returns price, pulse direction with confidence, macro regime (bull/bear/risk_on/risk_off/choppy), macro context (DXY, VIX, fear/greed). Add context='7d' for percentile rankings. Cost: 0.25 USDC. 15 tokens.

token.description: Token symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, LINK, BNB, ATOM, DOT, ARB, SUI, OP, LTC)

context.description: Historical context window: '7d' or '30d'. Adds percentile rankings vs recent history.

max_age_seconds.description: Freshness contract — reject cached data older than N seconds. Default: 3600.

tools.name: market.orderflow
tools.description: Cross-exchange orderflow from 20 live venues. Returns CVD direction/value, whale bar count (1h), liquidation pressure, buy_ratio, spot/perp delta, volume concentration (HHI). volume_herfindahl >0.6 = manipulation risk. Cost: 0.50 USDC. 24 tokens.

tools.name: market.full
tools.description: Complete pre-trade analysis. All market + orderflow data plus a grounded LLM call. Returns stance (BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL), orderflow_signal (ACCUMULATION/DISTRIBUTION/NEUTRAL), risk_level (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL), warnings[], and a verdict citing specific data values. Cost: 0.75 USDC. 15 tokens.

tools.name: address.risk
tools.description: On-chain address risk profile. Auto-detects EVM (0x...) or Solana (base58). Returns address_type, entity_label, account_age_days, tx_count, native_balance, top 5 tokens, risk_level (low/medium/high/unknown), flags (new_account, low_activity, unverified_contract, dormant, high_throughput). Cost: 0.25 USDC.

address.description: EVM (0x...) or Solana (base58) address to analyze
